body.label: Effect
body.html: Move up to half your Movement, then choose one creature within natural weapon range. On a success, deal 1 damage with a natural weapon.

surges.html: Increase this Action's natural weapon reach by 1 unit.

rider.title: STRIDER ADAPTATION
rider.html: Before resolving this Action, you may assume Fleet Form. While maintained: Increase your Movement by 2.
